concept: Aurora Global Database: cross-Region DR with fast promotion
tests: Which Aurora feature provides cross-Region DR with minimal RTO via a continuously updated replica.
expected: Aurora Global Database (or a cross-Region read replica) — replication to another Region with ~1 s lag, fast promotion. Triggers: "another Region", "minimal RTO", "continuously updated read replica", "fast promotion".
why_not: Automated snapshots — slow recovery; Multi-AZ doesn't protect against a Region failure; manual export to S3 — high RPO and slow recovery.
